name: Sheila A. Berta
biography: Sheila Ayelen Berta is an Information Security Specialist and Developer, who started at 12 years-old by herself. At the age of 15, she wrote her first book about Web Hacking, published by RedUSERS Editorial in several countries. Over the years, she has discovered lots of vulnerabilities in popular web applications, softwares and given courses of Hacking Techniques in universities and private institutes. Sheila currently works at Eleven Paths as Security Researcher who specializes in offensive techniques, reverse engineering and exploit writing. She is also a developer in ASM (microcontrollers, x32/x64), C/C++ and Python. Sheila is an international speaker who has spoken at important security conferences such as Black Hat EU 2017, DEF CON 25 CHV, HITBSecConf, Ekoparty Security Conference, IEEE ArgenCon, Hack.Lu, OWASP Latam Tour and others. @UnaPibaGeek
